name: bnContextQA: Long-Context Question Answering Benchmark for Bangla
description: bnContextQA is an evaluation benchmark dataset designed to investigate positional bias and the 'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon in Large Language Models when processing long-context text in Bangla. Presented at BLP-2025, it contains 350 long-context question-answering instances, each paired with 30 context paragraphs across multiple controlled position permutations (10,500 total evaluation instances).
